{"parse":{"title":"EURO STOXX 50","pageid":2664593,"redirects":[],"wikitext":"{{Short description|Blue chip stock market index}} {{Infobox Index |name = EURO STOXX 50 Index |logo = |image = |caption = |foundation = 26 February 1998 |operator = [[STOXX]] |constituents = 50 |cap_level = Mega cap |mcap = €4.011 trillion (Aug 2023)[https://www.stoxx.com/document/Indices/Factsheets/2023/August/SX5GT.pdf EURO STOXX 50], 17 September 2023 |weighting = [[Capitalization-weighted index|Free-float market capitalization]] |related = [[STOXX Europe 50]] |homepage = {{URL|1=https://stoxx.com/index/sx5e/}} }} The '''EURO STOXX 50''' is a [[stock index]] of [[Eurozone]] stocks designed by [[STOXX]], an index provider that has been part of the ISS STOXX group, majority-owned by the [[Deutsche Börse|Deutsche Börse Group]], since November 2023.{{Cite web |title=History & milestones |url=https://stoxx.com/company/stoxx-history-milestones/ |website=stoxx.com |publisher=STOXX |access-date=24 October 2026}}{{Cite press release |title=STOXX Blue-Chip Indices Composition Changes (Sep. 01, 2026) |url=https://stoxx.com/stoxx-blue-chip-indices-composition-changes-sep-01-2026/ |publisher=STOXX |date=1 September 2026 |access-date=24 October 2026}} The index is composed of 50 stocks from countries of the Eurozone.{{cite web |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/SX5E:IND |title=About EURO STOXX 50 Price EUR|website= Bloomberg|publisher= |access-date=5 July 2022 |url-access=subscription }} EURO STOXX 50 represents Eurozone [[Blue chip (stock market)|blue-chip]] companies considered as leaders in their respective sectors.{{Cite web |date=2026 |title=EURO STOXX 50 |url=https://stoxx.com/index/sx5e/ |access-date=2026-07-07 |website=STOXX}} It is made up of fifty of the largest and most liquid stocks. The index futures and options on the EURO STOXX 50, traded on [[Eurex]], are among the most liquid products in Europe and the world. {| class="wikitable" |+Contract Specifications{{Cite web |title=Historical Euro Stoxx 50 Intraday Data (DSX) |url=https://portaracqg.com/historical-futures-data/euro-stoxx-50-intraday-dsx/ |access-date=2022-08-31 |website=PortaraCQG |df=dmy-all}} !Euro Stoxx 50 (DSX) ! |- |Exchange: |EUREX |- |Sector: |Index |- |Tick Size: |1 |- |Tick Value: |10 EUR |- |BPV: |10 |- |Denomination: |EUR |- |Decimal Place: |1 |} The EURO STOXX 50 was introduced on 26 February 1998. The EURO STOXX 50 Index represents some of the largest companies in the [[Eurozone]] in terms of [[free-float]] market capitalization. The index captures about 60% of the free-float market capitalization of the EURO STOXX Total Market Index (TMI), which in turn covers about 95% of the free-float market capitalization of the represented countries. The EURO STOXX 50 is one of the most liquid indices for the [[Eurozone]]. ==Historical performance== {{image frame|content= {{ChartDirect | x = 1998, 1999, 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 | y1 = 3342, 4904, 4772, 3806, 2386, 2761, 2951, 3579, 4120, 4400, 2451, 2966, 2793, 2317, 2636, 3109, 3146, 3268, 3291, 3504, 3001, 3745, 3552, 4298, 3793, 4522, 4896, 5791 | y1Title = Indexpoints }} |caption=Performance of the ''Euro Stoxx 50'' stock market index since 1998

==Calculation== The calculation of the indices employ the [[Étienne Laspeyres|Laspeyres]] formula, which measures price changes against a fixed base quantity weight:[http://www.stoxx.com/download/indices/rulebooks/stoxx_calculation_guide.pdf STOXX Calculation Guide] December 2022 :Index_t=\frac{\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^n (p_{it}\cdot s_{it}\cdot ff_{it}\cdot cf_{it}\cdot x_{it})}{D_{t}}=\frac{M_{t}}{D_{t}} where: vcc:FdDF :t = Time the index is computed :n = Number of companies in the index :pit = Price of company (i) at time (t) :sit = Number of shares of company (i) at time (t) :ffit = [[Public float|Free-float]] factor of company (i) at time (t) :cfit = Weighting cap factor of company (i) at time (t) :xit = Exchange rate from local currency into index currency for company (i) at time (t) :Mt = Free-float market capitalization of the index at time (t) :Dt = Divisor of the index at time (t) Changes in weights due to corporate actions are distributed proportionally across all index components. The index divisors, which is adjusted to maintain the continuity of the values of the index across changes due to corporate actions, are calculated as follows: :D_{t+1}=D_t \cdot \frac{\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^n (p_{it}\cdot s_{it}\cdot ff_{it}\cdot cf_{it}\cdot x_{it})\pm \Delta MC_{t+1}}{\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^n (p_{it}\cdot s_{it}\cdot ff_{it}\cdot cf_{it}\cdot x_{it})} where ΔMCt+1 = The difference between the closing market capitalization of the index and the adjusted closing market capitalization of the index: for companies with corporate actions effective at time (t+1), the free-float market capitalization is calculated with adjusted closing prices, the new number of shares at time (t+1) and the free-float factor at time (t+1) minus the free-float market capitalization calculated with closing prices, number of shares at time (t) and free-float factor at time (t). Buffers are used to achieve the fixed number of components and to maintain stability of the indices by reducing index composition changes. Selection [[methodology]] ensures a stable and up-to-date index composition. Fast-entry and fast-exit rules ensure the index accurately represents the performance of only the biggest and most [[market liquidity|liquid]] stocks. ==Composition== The composition of EURO STOXX 50 is reviewed annually in September. The index is available in several currency (AUD, CAD, CHF, EUR, GBP, JPY, USD) and return (Price, Net Return, Gross Return) variant combinations.{{Cite web |title=STOXX Index Methodology Guide (Portfolio Based Indices) |url=https://www.stoxx.com/document/Indices/Common/Indexguide/stoxx_index_guide.pdf |publisher=STOXX |date=October 2026 |pages=100–102 |format=PDF |access-date=24 October 2026}} Calculation takes place every 15 seconds between 09:00 CET and 18:00 CET for the EUR and USD variants of any return type, while the CAD, GBP and JPY variants are available as end-of-day calculation only (18:00 CET). The EURO STOXX 50 Index is derived from the 20 EURO STOXX Supersector indices (19 before the September 2020 review). {{As of|2026|09|21}}, the countries with the most companies represented are [[France]] and [[Germany]], with 16 companies each. {{As of|2026|09|21}}, following the annual review in which [[Engie]] and [[Nokia]] replaced [[Wolters Kluwer]] and [[Volkswagen Group|Volkswagen]] preference shares, Euro Stoxx 50 consists of the following companies:{{Cite web |title=EURO STOXX 50® – Components |url=https://stoxx.com/index/sx5e/?components=true |website=stoxx.com |publisher=STOXX |access-date=24 October 2026}} {| class="wikitable sortable" id="constituents" style="white-space: nowrap" ! serves as the basis for single sub-indices such as the EURO STOXX 50 ex Financials, which excludes all companies assigned to the [[Industry Classification Benchmark|ICB]] code 30 (code 8000 before the September 2020 review). EURO STOXX 50 is used for as underlying index for other financial products or for performance [[benchmarking]] purposes. Additionally, the index serves as an underlying for many [[trading strategy index|strategy indices]], such as the EURO STOXX 50 Risk Control Indices. The index is used as an underlying for [[Exchange-traded fund | ETF]]s and derivative financial instruments such as [[Futures contract | future]]s and [[Option (finance) | option]]s. ==Planned methodology changes== On 6 October 2026, following a market consultation, STOXX announced a phased overhaul of the index methodology:{{Cite web |title=EURO STOXX 50 index to undergo methodology changes from 2027 |url=https://stoxx.com/euro-stoxx-50-index-to-undergo-methodology-changes-from-2027/ |website=stoxx.com |publisher=STOXX |date=6 October 2026 |access-date=24 October 2026}} * From the September 2027 review, fast exits occurring in March, June, September and December will be implemented at the close of the third Friday of the month, aligned with the regular review and rebalancing schedule. * From the September 2028 review, the index will be reviewed semiannually, in March and September, with the first March review in 2029. * From the September 2029 review, the Supersector constraint used in stock selection since the index's launch in 1998 will be removed: all eligible stocks will be ranked by free-float market capitalization, while the existing 40–60 selection buffer is retained. ==See also== *[[STOXX Europe 50]] (a similar index not limited to the Eurozone) *[[STOXX Europe 600]] *[[S&P Europe 350]] (a similar but broader index for European stocks maintained by [[S&P Global|S&P]]) ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * [https://stoxx.com/index/sx5e/ EURO STOXX 50 page] * [https://www.stoxx.com/download/indices/factsheets/SX5GT.pdf EURO STOXX 50 Fact sheet] * [https://www.stoxx.com/document/Indices/Common/Indexguide/stoxx_index_guide.pdf STOXX Index Methodology Guide] * [https://www.bloomberg.com/apps/quote?ticker=SX5E:IND Bloomberg page for SX5E:IND] * [https://finance.yahoo.com/q?s=^STOXX50E Yahoo!
